title: Iterating ALL ( column ) with a measure gives the orphan rows' total on the blank row

source.quote: it links all the orphaned rows on the many-side to the blank row on the one-side
source.supports: the orphan Sales rows are linked to the blank row of Product

source.quote: In every case, ALL includes in the result the additional blank row generated for invalid relationships

derivation: Red is Bike (100) and Bell (no sales): 100. Blue is Lock: 30. The blank row's color is BLANK; the context transition filters Color to BLANK, which selects the blank row and so the orphan Sales rows 3 and 4: 50 + 20 = 70.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
